30110.a:
**Koordinatsiya narxini bit-budjetga almashtirish: Snowflake = 41 bit ms + 10 bit worker ID + 12 bit sequence.**

- Talab: global unikal, vaqt bo'yicha o'suvchi, koordinatsiyasiz, 64-bit.
- ~69 yil epoch, ms ichida 4096 ID → ~4M ID/s bir node'da.
- Worker ID: etcd/ZooKeeper yoki StatefulSet ordinal — ikki node bir ID olsa kolliziya.
- Soat orqaga ketsa — kutish yoki xato.
- Alternativa: UUIDv7/ULID (128-bit), DB `hi/lo` blok ajratish.
- Auto-increment: bitta koordinatsiya nuqtasi, tashqariga enumeration.
- Tashqi API'da opaque ID.

30111.a:
**Ulanish holatini yo'naltirish, tartib va ID, guruh fan-out, offline yetkazish.**

- WebSocket gateway (stateful), `user_id → pod` Redis'da TTL bilan.
- Client → gateway → message service → Kafka + qabul qiluvchi gateway'ga pub/sub; offline — push.
- Saqlash: `(conversation_id, message_id)`, monoton ID → kursor; Cassandra/partitionlangan Postgres.
- At-least-once + `client_msg_id` dedup; read receipt guruhda agregatlangan.
- Kichik guruh — write fan-out, katta kanal — read fan-out.
- Presence: heartbeat + TTL, faqat ochiq chatlarga, throttling.
- Tartib — server sequence.
- E2E bo'lsa server qidiruv/moderatsiya qila olmaydi.

30112.a:
**Lokatsiya o'tkinchi ma'lumot, zichlikka mos katak, tayinlashning atomikligi.**

- 100k / 5s ≈ 20k RPS — xotira/Redis'da; tarix — Kafka → ombor. Har yozuvni DB'ga — klassik xato.
- Indeks: geohash/S2/H3, `GEOSEARCH`; qo'shni kataklar.
- Katak o'lchami zichlikka qarab (markaz kichik).
- Nomzodlar geo bo'yicha → ETA (yo'l grafi) bo'yicha tanlash.
- `available → assigned` atomik, taklif TTL bilan (15s).
- Shahar/region bo'yicha shardlash.
- Eskirgan lokatsiya — stale belgisi.

30113.a:
**Katta faylni backend'dan o'tkazmaslik, uzun ishni idempotent chunk'larga bo'lish, holat mashinasi.**

- Presigned URL, multipart, resumable.
- S3 event → navbat → transcode; `uploaded → processing → ready/failed`.
- Segmentlarga bo'lib parallel, har biri bir necha sifat + HLS/DASH; idempotent (`video_id + rendition + chunk`).
- Alohida worker pool, spot instance, prioritet navbat.
- CDN + imzolangan URL, adaptive bitrate.
- Qisman natija: mavjud sifatlar bilan chiqarish.
- Thumbnail, subtitr, moderatsiya — alohida consumer.

30114.a:
**Qidiruvni so'rov vaqtida bajarmaslik: oldindan hisoblangan `prefiks → top-N` snapshot + xotiradagi struktura.**

- Trie (har tugunda top-K) yoki KV/ZSET.
- Reyting: chastota + yangilik + shaxsiylashtirish qatlami.
- Log'lardan davriy batch → yangi snapshot atomik almashtiriladi.
- Qisqa prefikslar — CDN/edge.
- Typo uchun fuzzy (edit distance ≤ 1).
- Filtr: taqiqlangan so'zlar, shaxsiy ma'lumot sizmasin.
- Har podda to'liq trie yoki prefiks bo'yicha shard.

30115.a:
**Redis sorted set; lekin Redis haqiqat manbai emas, davrlar va approximate rank bilan masshtab.**

- `ZADD`, `ZREVRANGE` (top), `ZREVRANK` (o'rin) — O(log N); 10M bitta instansiyaga sig'adi.
- Top-N 1–5s keshda.
- Ball o'zgarishi DB'ga event; rebuild skripti.
- Davr kalitda (`lb:2026-09`), TTL bilan.
- Juda katta — bucket'lar bilan taxminiy o'rin.
- Anti-cheat: ball serverda hisoblanadi.
- Do'stlar reytingi — kichik alohida hisob.

30116.a:
**Lease + idempotentlik, DST edge case'lari, 00:00 herd.**

- `jobs(next_run_at, status, attempt...)`, `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`.
- Exactly-once yo'q: lease + `run_key = (job_id, scheduled_for)` unique.
- Worker o'lsa lease tugab qaytariladi → bajarish idempotent; N urinishdan keyin DLQ.
- Vaqt zonasi, DST, catch-up yoki skip siyosati.
- 00:00 ga jitter, tenant bo'yicha limit.
- Kechikish metrikasi (scheduled vs actual).

30117.a:
**Overselling'ni DB atomik sharti bilan yopish va 500k trafikni inventarga yetkazmaslik.**

- Virtual navbat (waiting room), statik sahifa CDN'da.
- Har joy alohida yozuv; `UPDATE ... SET status='held', hold_until=now()+'10 min' WHERE seat_no=$1 AND status='free'`.
- Hold muddati — lazy expiry.
- To'lov idempotency key bilan, noma'lum — reconcile.
- Redis'da tez "joy yo'q" javobi, yakuniy haqiqat DB.
- Bot himoyasi: akkaunt/karta/IP limit, CAPTCHA.
- Nomerlanmagan joy — atomik hisoblagich + `qty >= 0` constraint.

30118.a:
**Cardinality — asosiy xavf; downsampling qatlamlari; monitoring mustaqil klasterda.**

- Agentlar batch + siqilgan yuboradi → gateway → Kafka (buffer, backpressure).
- TSDB (VictoriaMetrics, ClickHouse): delta-of-delta, XOR — nuqta ~1–2 bayt.
- Label'da user_id/URL — seriya portlaydi → limit va hisobot.
- Xom 15 kun, 5 daq agregat 3 oy, 1 soatlik 13 oy.
- Recording rules, query timeout va limit.
- Seriya hash bo'yicha shard, 2 replika.
- Monitoring kuzatilayotgan tizimdan mustaqil.

30119.a:
**Content-addressed chunking + alohida metadata + kursorli o'zgarishlar jurnali.**

- 4 MB chunk (content-defined yaxshiroq), SHA-256 bilan adreslash → dedup, delta sync.
- Metadata (daraxt, versiya, chunk ro'yxati) — DB; chunk'lar — immutable obyekt.
- Sync: `journal_id` kursori, long-poll/push.
- Konflikt: `parent_version` tekshiruvi → "conflicted copy" (avtomatik merge — zaif javob).
- Resumable upload, metadata atomik yangilanadi.
- Shifrlash, imzolangan URL.
- Cross-user dedup — "hash oracle" xavfi → per-user.

30120.a:
**Bloom filter + domen bo'yicha shardlash + adaptiv recrawl; politeness va tuzoqlar.**

- Frontier: prioritet, domen bo'yicha navbat — 1 so'rov/s, `robots.txt`.
- Dedup: URL normalizatsiyasi + Bloom filter + aniq KV tekshiruvi.
- Kontent: simhash/minhash.
- Tuzoqlar: cheksiz kalendar — chuqurlik limitlari; timeout; redirect limiti.
- Domen hash bo'yicha shard — politeness tabiiy.
- Recrawl o'zgarish chastotasiga qarab, `ETag`/`Last-Modified`.
- Xom HTML — obyekt saqlash.

30121.a:
**Qaror ma'lumot egaligi va izchillik talabidan kelib chiqadi.**

- Ma'lumot regionga bo'linsa (home region) — active-active oson.
- Global qat'iy izchillik — har yozuvga 50–150 ms → ko'pincha active-passive.
- Konflikt: LWW jimgina yo'qotadi → CRDT, biznes merge yoki entity egaligi.
- Cross-region oqim at-least-once, dedup.
- GeoDNS, sessiya home region'ga yopishadi.
- RTO/RPO raqamda, failover mashq qilingan, kvorum.
- Narx: trafik, 2x sig'im, murakkablik.
- O'rta yo'l: o'qish global, yozish bitta region.

30122.a:
**1M/s ni tarmoqqa chiqarmaslik (lokal baholash) va control plane yiqilganda xavfsiz degradatsiya.**

- SDK butun konfigni xotirada ushlaydi — mikrosekundlik baholash.
- Tarqatish: SSE/WebSocket yoki qisqa polling; CDN'da versiyalangan snapshot.
- Fail-safe: konfig olinmasa — koddagi default.
- Foizli yoyish: `hash(flag_key + user_id) % 100 < percent` — sticky.
- Audit, kritik flaglarga approval, kill switch.
- Telemetriya: agregat sanoq, trace'ga flag qiymati.
- Har flagga ega va muddat.

30233.a:
**Pul bilan ishlash intizomi: idempotentlik, noma'lum holat, outbox, ledger, reconciliation.**

- `payment_intent` + idempotency key; holat: `created → authorized → captured → settled` / failed / refunded.
- DB tranzaksiyada intent + outbox; PSP chaqiruvi tranzaksiyadan TASHQARIDA.
- PSP adapterlari (ACL), routing qoidalari; fallback'dan oldin holat aniqlanadi.
- Timeout — o'sha key bilan retry yoki status; hal bo'lmasa `pending` + reconcile.
- Webhook: imzo, idempotent, versiya bo'yicha; davriy pull ham.
- Double-entry ledger; hisobot ledger'dan.
- Tokenizatsiya, o'zgarmas audit, KMS.
- Dublikat to'lov alerti — eng muhim.

30234.a:
**Oldindan agregatlash, tenant kvotalari, kechikkan hodisalarni qayta hisoblash, HyperLogLog.**

- SDK → gateway (validatsiya, tenant, rate limit) → Kafka; schema registry, DLQ.
- ClickHouse: `(tenant_id, event_date, event_name)` partition/sort; xom + materialized view.
- Dashboard — agregatdan; ad-hoc — kvota bilan.
- Noisy neighbour: query kvotasi, alohida pool, kritik mijozga alohida klaster.
- HLL va sampling.
- Xom 30–90 kun, agregat yillar, sovuq — S3.
- Offline qurilma 3 kun kechikadi → qayta hisoblash oynasi.

💡 "Postgres'da GROUP BY" bu hajmda ishlamaydi.
